utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ll bring my flashlight, basic tools, and the pickup truck, and I can help keep track of the houses we’ve checked. Just point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Bo — that’s really helpful. I’m still waiting on the last couple confirmations, then I’ll send the final repair drive details to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send the final details when you’ve got them, and I’ll be ready with the truck and tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch. I’m pulling together the sign-up list and the remaining repairs so we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll shift the school-schedule coordination to Sunday at the community center and send Opal the location and timing. Once Oren confirms the final time, I’ll share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Faye — thank you. Once Oren confirms the final time, send it along and I’ll keep the sign-up list and repair summary updated.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive is this Saturday from 9 to 2 at the community center, by the side entrance near the loading bay. I might be mixing up the details, but I’m keeping the list tidy and checking the supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, that’s right — I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside anything that needs sharpening. We should be good to go at the side entrance near the loading bay.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the list tidy and make sure we’re set for Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive and asking neighbors to bring any small things that need fixing. If you’ve got anything, send it my way and I’ll pass along the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ve got my drill for Saturday afternoon, and I think Oren’s still confirming the exact time. I’ll send along anything else if I hear of it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks—your drill will be really helpful, and I’ll keep an eye out for Oren’s timing. If anyone else confirms, just send it over and I’ll share the final details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday works for the repair drive. I’ll handle the rest of the items, and we’re set with Rey, Bo, and Noah for their parts too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’m running errands now, but I’ll swing by the repair drive soon and help out. I still need the exact drop-off spot and timing, and I’ll check in as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — the drop-off spot is the usual community center lot, and we’ll start Saturday morning. Check in when you can, and I’ll keep the rest covered.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word right away and invite a few neighbors who can help. I’ll also ask folks to bring any tools or supplies they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. Once the item list is sorted, I’ll send it over to Bo.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send it my way and I’ll pass it along to the neighbors right away.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, let me know if you still need me to bring anything for the repair drive. I’m helping Jules sort the tools, so I can grab whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I think we’re set on tools for now. If you can, just help spread the word that we still need a few more hands for sorting donations and carrying boxes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll spread the word and keep an eye out if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s at the community center from 9 to 2, and you can drop things off at the side entrance near the loading bay. I’ll keep an ear out for any volunteer needs too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’m still waiting on the last details before I pass it along, but that helps a lot. I’ll share it once I’ve got the full update.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — if you hear anything else, send it my way and I’ll keep Quinn posted too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to hear it’s going steadily. Do you have the pickup address and do we still need a trunk space car by Friday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can get you the pickup address, and we could still use a trunk-space car by Friday afternoon if someone’s able to help. I’ve got a couple more tools I can lend too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, send me the pickup address. I can help check for a trunk-space car by Friday afternoon too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — the repair drive runs at the community center from 9 to 2, and folks should use the side entrance by the loading bay.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — I want to double-check that 9 to 2 matches Saturday afternoon, since Oren was going to confirm the time. We still need a few more hands for sorting donations and carrying boxes, too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, 9 to 2 is the plan for Saturday afternoon, and I’ll keep it steady unless Vik says otherwise. If he needs anything, I’ll let Dane know and I’m still counting on Oren’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. I can sort donations, and Saturday still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rey — sorting donations will help a lot. I’ll check the supply bin and make a fresh list so we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — let me know what’s still needed after you check the bin.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on Faye to send the location and timing before I organize the repair drive details. Bo’s bringing a flashlight and basic tools, and he’ll help me keep track of which houses we’ve already checked.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So we still don’t have the exact time, drop-off details, or pickup address yet, right? And Ira’s on his way and will check in soon?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That’s right—we still need Faye’s location and timing before I can organize the details. I’ll confirm the drop-off and pickup info as soon as she sends it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Saturday works for me. I can sort donations and carry boxes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, Saturday at the community center from 9 to 2 sounds good, and the side entrance by the loading bay is the drop-off. I’m just waiting on the last couple confirmations, then I’ll send the final details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll be there Saturday and can help with both sorting donations and carrying boxes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got my pickup, a flashlight, and some basic tools ready. I can help check off the houses we’ve already covered too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Nice, that helps a lot. Let me know if you still need me to bring anything for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m set on my end—just bring yourself if you can. I’ll be there with the truck and tools, and we’ll keep the house list moving.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so the repair drive is still on, but the exact time, drop-off, and pickup address still need to be confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that’s right — Oren’s still confirming the exact time, and Faye’ll pass the location and timing to Opal after that. I’m bringing my drill Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so we’re still waiting on the exact time, and the drop-off and pickup details aren’t set yet, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: We still need the pickup address and someone with a trunk or extra space by Friday afternoon. Once we have those details, I think we can make the repair drive work.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still waiting on Faye for the repair drive location and timing before I lock in the details. Bo’s set with a flashlight and basic tools, and he can help me keep track of the houses once we start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That makes sense — once Faye sends the location and timing, I can help line up the pickup and trunk space. I’m just trying to keep the Friday afternoon handoff from getting messy.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m running errands right now, but I’ll swing by the repair drive soon to help out. I still need the exact drop-off spot, so I’ll check in as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — come to the community center side entrance near the loading bay, and we’re there from 9 to 2. I’ll sort the donated tools and set aside anything that needs sharpening.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll head to the community center side entrance near the loading bay while I finish errands. Thanks for sorting the tools; I’ll check in as soon as I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supply bin and make a fresh list for the repair drive. Rey’s helping sort donations and carry boxes, so we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Cleo — thank you. I’ll fold that into the sign-up list and keep everything lined up for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thank you, Rosa. I’ll check the bin and get that fresh list ready so we know what still needs to be gathered.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll send a short blurb for Saturday afternoon that mentions the loose steps and broken fence panel. We could still use a few more hands for sorting donations and carrying boxes, too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it — I’ll spread the word right away and invite a few neighbors who can pitch in. I’ll also ask them to bring any tools or supplies they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll keep the blurb short and focused, and mention the extra hands and any tools or supplies if useful.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on the final details before I pass anything along, but I know Quinn’s asking folks to bring any tools or supplies they can spare. Rosa’s helping keep everyone updated, too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ve still got a couple more tools I can lend, and I’m already helping sort donations and carry boxes. Once the details are set, just let me know what to bring over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s really helpful, Gus—thank you. I’ll pass along the final details as soon as I get them and let you know what still needs to come over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for checking in, Eli — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive and asking folks to bring small items that need fixing. If you have anything, bring it by and I’ll make sure it gets looked at.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Jules. I’ll keep the plan steady and let Dane know if Vik needs anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Eli — I’ll pass that along and keep neighbors in the loop. If you hear back from Vik or spot anyone with a small repair, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s at the community center from 9 to 2, and you can drop things off by the side entrance near the loading bay. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates or volunteer needs too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Tess. Once the item list is sorted, I’ll send it to Bo and keep you posted on any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Leo—send it over when it’s ready, and I’ll pass along any gaps or updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—just send the time when you’ve got it, and I’ll keep it lined up with the school schedule. Then I can pass along the location and timing to Opal, too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, got it — Saturday from 9 to 2 at the community center, side entrance by the loading bay. I’ll send that along so you can keep it lined up with pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll keep that window clear around pickup and pass the location and timing to Opal. Thanks, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll handle the rest of the items for Saturday’s repair drive. Bo can keep track of the checked houses, and I know Rey and Noah have their parts covered too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good — can you send me the pickup address for Pia, and make sure whoever goes has a trunk or extra space?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can send Pia’s pickup address, and I’ll make sure the folks heading out have trunk space or extra room.
